bio: BA, Morehouse College MDiv, Harvard Divinity School DMin, Candler School of Theology, Emory University Jeremy D. Battle is the senior pastor at the The Avenue: The Historic Massachusetts Avenue & Western Avenue Baptist Church. He began serving as senior pastor of the Western Avenue Baptist Church in Cambridge in 2011. He is originally from Brighton, Alabama. For more information, see his profile page on The Avenue website. Leslie MacPherson Affiliation Denominational Counselor
